briefdescription.para: C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ human test reporter.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the declaration for reporter_human, a concrete implementation of the reporter abstract interface, selected with the --reporter=human command-line option, or with runner_options::selected_reporter (the default is TAP). It formats and presents test results in a human-readable form on the standard output, accumulating output in an internal string buffer and supporting colour-coded diagnostics and multiple verbosity levels.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail namespace, since the reporters are internal to the framework.
The header files are organised within the include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
